face.do_not_change: Never alter face geometry, marks, or eye color across slides.

body.do_not_change: Keep the same body proportions and silhouette across every frame.

LOCKED.conflict_rule: When VARIATIONS disagree with LOCKED, LOCKED always wins. Never invent new facial marks or change body proportions.

VARIATIONS.framing: portrait 1024x1536, subject centered, phone-camera depth of field

reference_assets.notes: Generate face_lock and body_lock once after identity approval. Attach both on every image request. Do not regenerate locks after approval.

generation_contract.provider_notes: Prefer photorealistic phone-camera look unless visual_style says otherwise. Repeat LOCKED face + body + signature in every prompt.

image_generation_request.locked_block: Use LOCKED.identity, LOCKED.face, LOCKED.body, LOCKED.signature verbatim.
